caveats: a handful of games: no interval, no inference; the coverage columns are mechanics, the P&L columns are anecdotes
the availability rule trades on a board that is on average ~8 minutes old at the decision instant (executability block); the control's board is younger but loses most games to commit latency
T-45 differs from the control in two things (offset AND board rule); the matched comparators (T-60 available, T-45 strict) separate them
settled P&L, CLV and drift use the final archives; none of it was available to the selection
retrospective reconstruction runs the sealer at the first minute of each window with commit-time filters, so it reproduces what a live sealer would have written; it is still uncounted

coverage.instants_note: games that tip at the same time share one decision instant and therefore one board: their exclusion is perfectly correlated, so the number of independent coverage observations is the number of distinct instants

executability.note: drift is observed AFTER the decision and never used in a selection; adverse = the ask moved up before the next board

clv_cents.note: only trades with a VALID closing line (two-sided, <= 15 min before tip) count

computation_lag_s.note: decided_utc - as_of_utc: how long after the information cut-off the decision row was actually computed (asof_replay)

evidence_status.authority: none; never a value claim below the minimums
evidence_status.label: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE

exposure_concentration.note: trades on one player-game share one outcome (points/PRA/threes of the same player are strongly correlated)

independent_units.note: rungs, sides and snapshots are never independent bets; the unit is the game (cluster) and the player-game

max_drawdown.note: dollars, 1 contract per position, ordered by tip time; a path statistic of a handful of games, not a risk estimate

predicted_ev.note: predicted by the model at the decision instant, before any outcome

overlap.reading: descriptive; each lane keeps its own ledger and exposure caps, so a shared contract is two separate shadow positions

projection_accuracy_all_games.rule: the denominator is every game with settled forecasts. TRADED, EVALUATED_NO_TRADE, EXCLUDED_* and NO_SEAL games are all scored; a trade decision, a missing board or a lane exclusion never removes a game from the accuracy evaluation

scope: Retrospective reconstruction of both lanes' sealers over the games since 2026-10-20 on the final archives (uncounted, descriptive) plus two matched comparators that change one thing at a time; prospective, counted evidence is read only from each lane's own sealed ledger and is not available yet (control start 2026-10-24T06:00Z; T-45 start 2026-10-27T06:00Z, after approval).
